description: Compare two people's charts (synastry) from their birth data. Returns the overall tone (flowing, mixed or charged), whether the Sun elements match, the classic pairings (Venus-Mars, Sun-Moon, Moon-Moon, Venus-Venus), the tightest Moon, Venus, Mars and Sun contacts between the two charts, and a link to the free full comparison on lunonis.com. Counted aspects only: there is no compatibility score. Nothing is stored.

place.description: Birth city name (e.g. "Lviv" or "Lviv, Ukraine"), or a place id from search_places. A name shared by several cities returns candidates to choose from.

time.description: Birth time, 24-hour HH:MM local time. Omit if unknown: the rising sign and houses are then left out, never guessed.
